evidence.V1: Silhouette reads as a plank-top table from 3/4, front and top: overhanging slatted top, four turned legs with bulb feet, H-stretcher; outline symmetric (A15 X/Y 0.0).
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: big slab top + apron, medium turned legs and stretchers, small ink nail heads and board gaps.
evidence.V3: Chunky overhanging top and swelling turned legs with bulb feet give a stylised read; overall height (3.3 studs vs 7.3 long) reads slightly bench-like.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers on board edges and apron catch light in the corner close-up; stretchers have a smaller but present bevel.
evidence.V5: No z-fighting or pinches, but the low-segment turned legs show visible vertical facet bands in the leg close-up (minor).
evidence.V6: Disciplined: two/three wood values alternating per board plus ink nail heads; colourways keep the same value structure.
evidence.V8: Single LF_VertexColor material, smooth shading, ~0.05-stud chamfers, wood hue + ink iron as per furniture spec.
evidence.V9: Anchored, CollisionFidelity Box, CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre; all gates pass.

evidence.V1: Plank top on four turned legs with H-stretcher reads as a table/bench from front, three-quarter and silhouette; top view reads as a four-plank top.

evidence.V6: One wood hue in three values (light/mid boards, dark apron/stretchers) plus ink nail heads; colourways recolour cleanly.
evidence.V8: Single vertex-coloured wood hue, ink iron nails, chamfered planks match the wave-2 furniture kit.
